<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function() {

    var c = this;


    /*
     * =========================================
     * DASHBOARD
     * =========================================
     */

    c.dashboard = function() {

        window.location.href =
            "?id=cfms_student";

    };


    /*
     * =========================================
     * RAISE REQUEST
     * =========================================
     */

    c.raiseRequest = function() {

        window.location.href =
            "?id=cfms_raise";

    };


    /*
     * =========================================
     * MY REQUESTS
     * =========================================
     */

    c.myRequests = function() {

        window.location.href =
            "?id=cfms_requests";

    };


    /*
     * =========================================
     * FEEDBACK
     * =========================================
     */

    c.feedback = function() {

        window.location.href =
            "?id=cfms_feedback";

    };

        window.location.href =
            "/logout.do";

};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* =========================================
   CFMS STUDENT DASHBOARD
   ========================================= */

.cfms-student-page {
    min-height: 100vh;

    background: #f0fbfc;

    color: #263238;

    font-family:
        "Segoe UI",
        Tahoma,
        Geneva,
        Verdana,
        sans-serif;
}


/* =========================================
   HEADER
   ========================================= */

.student-header {
    height: 72px;

    background: #00acc1;

    color: white;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;

    padding: 0 35px;

    box-sizing: border-box;
}


.student-brand {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 12px;
}


.brand-icon {
    width: 43px;
    height: 43px;

    border-radius: 9px;

    background: white;

    color: #00acc1;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 22px;
}


.student-brand h2 {
    margin: 0;

    font-size: 23px;

    line-height: 1.1;
}


.student-brand span {
    font-size: 11px;

    opacity: 0.9;
}


/* USER */

.student-user {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 10px;
}


.user-avatar {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: white;

    color: #00acc1;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;
}


.user-info {
    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;
}


.user-info strong {
    font-size: 14px;
}


.user-info span {
    font-size: 11px;

    opacity: 0.85;
}


.logout-btn {
    margin-left: 15px;

    padding: 8px 13px;

    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.7);

    background: transparent;

    color: white;

    border-radius: 6px;

    cursor: pointer;
}


.logout-btn:hover {
    background: white;

    color: #00acc1;
}


/* =========================================
   LAYOUT
   ========================================= */

.student-layout {
    display: flex;

    min-height: calc(100vh - 72px);
}


/* =========================================
   SIDEBAR
   ========================================= */

.student-sidebar {
    width: 235px;

    flex-shrink: 0;

    background: white;

    border-right: 1px solid #dceff1;

    padding: 25px 15px;

    box-sizing: border-box;
}


.sidebar-title {
    padding: 0 12px 15px;

    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 11px;

    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: 1px;
}


.sidebar-item {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 13px;

    padding: 13px 14px;

    margin-bottom: 5px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    color: #546e7a !important;

    text-decoration: none !important;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition: 0.2s ease;
}


.sidebar-item i {
    width: 20px;

    text-align: center;

    font-size: 17px;
}


.sidebar-item:hover {
    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #00acc1 !important;
}


.sidebar-item.active {
    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #00acc1 !important;

    font-weight: 600;
}


.sidebar-divider {
    height: 1px;

    background: #e5eeee;

    margin: 20px 10px;
}


/* =========================================
   MAIN CONTENT
   ========================================= */

.student-content {
    flex: 1;

    padding: 35px 45px;

    box-sizing: border-box;

    max-width: 1400px;
}


/* =========================================
   WELCOME
   ========================================= */

.welcome-section {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;

    margin-bottom: 30px;
}


.page-label {
    color: #00acc1;

    font-size: 11px;

    font-weight: 700;

    letter-spacing: 1px;
}


.welcome-section h1 {
    margin: 7px 0;

    font-size: 31px;

    color: #263238;
}


.welcome-section p {
    margin: 0;

    color: #607d8b;

    font-size: 14px;
}


.quick-request-btn {
    background: #00acc1;

    color: white;

    border: none;

    border-radius: 8px;

    padding: 13px 20px;

    font-size: 14px;

    font-weight: 600;

    cursor: pointer;
}


.quick-request-btn:hover {
    background: #008fa1;
}


/* =========================================
   STATISTICS
   ========================================= */

.stats-container {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(4, 1fr);

    gap: 18px;

    margin-bottom: 35px;
}


.stat-card {
    background: white;

    border-radius: 12px;

    padding: 20px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 15px;

    box-shadow:
        0 3px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);

    border: 1px solid #e3f1f3;
}


.stat-icon {
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 21px;
}


.stat-icon.teal {
    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #00acc1;
}


.stat-icon.blue {
    background: #e3f2fd;

    color: #1976d2;
}


.stat-icon.green {
    background: #e8f5e9;

    color: #43a047;
}


.stat-icon.orange {
    background: #fff3e0;

    color: #fb8c00;
}


.stat-details {
    display: flex;

    flex-direction: column;

    gap: 4px;
}


.stat-details span {
    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 12px;
}


.stat-details strong {
    color: #263238;

    font-size: 25px;
}


/* =========================================
   DASHBOARD SECTIONS
   ========================================= */

.dashboard-section {
    margin-bottom: 35px;
}


.section-heading {
    display: flex;

    justify-content: space-between;

    align-items: center;

    margin-bottom: 18px;
}


.section-heading h2 {
    margin: 0 0 5px;

    font-size: 21px;

    color: #263238;
}


.section-heading p {
    margin: 0;

    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 13px;
}


/* =========================================
   ACTION CARDS
   ========================================= */

.action-grid {
    display: grid;

    grid-template-columns:
        repeat(3, 1fr);

    gap: 20px;
}


.action-card {
    background: white;

    padding: 25px;

    border-radius: 13px;

    border: 1px solid #e1eff1;

    cursor: pointer;

    transition: all 0.25s ease;
}


.action-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);

    box-shadow:
        0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);

    border-color: #b2ebf2;
}


.action-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;

    border-radius: 10px;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 20px;

    margin-bottom: 15px;
}


.teal-bg {
    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #00acc1;
}


.blue-bg {
    background: #e3f2fd;

    color: #1976d2;
}


.orange-bg {
    background: #fff3e0;

    color: #fb8c00;
}


.action-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 8px;

    color: #263238;

    font-size: 17px;
}


.action-card p {
    margin: 0 0 17px;

    color: #607d8b;

    font-size: 13px;

    line-height: 1.6;
}


.action-link {
    color: #00acc1;

    font-size: 13px;

    font-weight: 600;
}


/* =========================================
   VIEW ALL
   ========================================= */

.view-all-btn {
    border: none;

    background: transparent;

    color: #00acc1;

    font-size: 13px;

    font-weight: 600;

    cursor: pointer;
}


/* =========================================
   EMPTY STATE
   ========================================= */

.empty-state {
    background: white;

    border-radius: 13px;

    padding: 45px 20px;

    text-align: center;

    border: 1px solid #e1eff1;
}


.empty-icon {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;

    margin: 0 auto 15px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #00acc1;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    font-size: 25px;
}


.empty-state h3 {
    margin: 0 0 7px;

    color: #263238;
}


.empty-state p {
    color: #78909c;

    font-size: 13px;
}


.empty-btn {
    margin-top: 10px;

    padding: 10px 17px;

    border: none;

    border-radius: 7px;

    background: #00acc1;

    color: white;

    cursor: pointer;
}


/* =========================================
   REQUEST LIST
   ========================================= */

.request-list {
    background: white;

    border-radius: 13px;

    border: 1px solid #e1eff1;

    overflow: hidden;
}


.request-row {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;

    padding: 17px 20px;

    border-bottom: 1px solid #edf4f5;
}


.request-row:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}


.request-main {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 13px;
}


.request-icon {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;

    border-radius: 8px;

    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #00acc1;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;
}


.request-main h4 {
    margin: 0 0 3px;

    font-size: 14px;

    color: #263238;
}


.request-main p {
    margin: 0;

    font-size: 12px;

    color: #78909c;
}


.status-badge {
    padding: 6px 10px;

    border-radius: 20px;

    font-size: 11px;

    background: #e0f7fa;

    color: #008fa1;
}


/* =========================================
   HELP
   ========================================= */

.help-card {
    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 20px;

    padding: 22px;

    border-radius: 12px;

    background: #4dd0e1;

    margin-bottom: 20px;
}


.help-icon {
    width: 45px;
    height: 45px;

    border-radius: 50%;

    background: white;

    color: #00acc1;

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    flex-shrink: 0;
}


.help-content {
    flex: 1;
}


.help-content h3 {
    margin: 0 0 5px;

    color: #263238;
}


.help-content p {
    margin: 0;

    color: #37474f;

    font-size: 13px;
}


.help-btn {
    background: #00acc1;

    color: white;

    border: none;

    padding: 10px 17px;

    border-radius: 7px;

    cursor: pointer;

    font-weight: 600;
}


/* =========================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ========================================= */

@media (max-width: 1100px) {

    .stats-container {
        grid-template-columns:
            repeat(2, 1fr);
    }

    .action-grid {
        grid-template-columns:
            repeat(2, 1fr);
    }

}


@media (max-width: 800px) {

    .student-sidebar {
        width: 70px;

        padding: 20px 8px;
    }

    .sidebar-title,
    .sidebar-item span {
        display: none;
    }

    .sidebar-item {
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .student-content {
        padding: 25px;
    }

}


@media (max-width: 600px) {

    .student-header {
        height: auto;

        padding: 15px 18px;
    }

    .student-brand span,
    .user-info {
        display: none;
    }

    .logout-btn {
        margin-left: 5px;
    }

    .welcome-section {
        flex-direction: column;

        align-items: flex-start;

        gap: 20px;
    }

    .stats-container,
    .action-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .student-content {
        padding: 20px 15px;
    }

    .help-card {
        flex-direction: column;

        text-align: center;
    }

}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>cfms_student_dashboard</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {  }]]></link><name>CFMS Student Dashboard</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {

    /*
     * =========================================
     * DEFAULT DATA
     * =========================================
     */

    data.userName = gs.getUserDisplayName();

    data.totalRequests = 0;

    data.activeRequests = 0;

    data.resolvedRequests = 0;

    data.feedbackCount = 0;

    data.recentRequests = [];


    /*
     * =========================================
     * SECURITY CHECK
     * =========================================
     */

    if (!gs.isLoggedIn()) {

        data.redirect = "cfms_login";

        return;

    }


    /*
     * =========================================
     * STUDENT ROLE CHECK
     * =========================================
     */

    if (!gs.hasRole("cfms_student") &&
        !gs.hasRole("admin")) {

        data.redirect = "cfms_home";

        return;

    }


    /*
     * =========================================
     * STUDENT REQUESTS
     *
     * Recommended table:
     * incident
     *
     * caller_id = logged-in student
     * =========================================
     */

    var requestGR = new GlideRecord("incident");

    requestGR.addQuery(
        "caller_id",
        gs.getUserID()
    );

    requestGR.orderByDesc("sys_created_on");

    requestGR.query();


    while (requestGR.next()) {

        data.totalRequests++;


        /*
         * Resolved
         */

        if (requestGR.state == 6 ||
            requestGR.state == 7) {

            data.resolvedRequests++;

        } else {

            data.activeRequests++;

        }


        /*
         * Recent 5 requests
         */

        if (data.recentRequests.length < 5) {

            var stateText =
                requestGR.getDisplayValue("state");

            var statusClass =
                "status-active";


            if (requestGR.state == 6 ||
                requestGR.state == 7) {

                statusClass =
                    "status-resolved";

            }


            data.recentRequests.push({

                number:
                    requestGR.getValue("number"),

                short_description:
                    requestGR.getValue(
                        "short_description"
                    ),

                state:
                    stateText,

                statusClass:
                    statusClass

            });

        }

    }


    /*
     * =========================================
     * FEEDBACK COUNT
     *
     * Recommended custom table:
     * u_cfms_feedback
     * =========================================
     */

    if (GlideTableDescriptor
        .isValid("u_cfms_feedback")) {

        var feedbackGR =
            new GlideRecord(
                "u_cfms_feedback"
            );

        feedbackGR.addQuery(
            "u_student",
            gs.getUserID()
        );

        feedbackGR.query();

        data.feedbackCount =
            feedbackGR.getRowCount();

    }


})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-24 10:11:37</sys_created_on><sys_id>c9a14459a02f03107f4432329b8a15b6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CFMS Student Dashboard</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Campus Food Services Assistant" source="x_snc_campus_foo_1">423299d7dd1f03107f44143a6accf8fb</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Campus Food Services Assistant">423299d7dd1f03107f44143a6accf8fb</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_c9a14459a02f03107f4432329b8a15b6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-24 10:22:03</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="cfms-student-page">

    <!-- =====================================
         TOP HEADER
         ===================================== -->

    <header class="student-header">

        <div class="student-brand">

            <div class="brand-icon">
                <i class="fa fa-cutlery"></i>
            </div>

            <div>
                <h2>CFMS</h2>
                <span>Campus Food Management System</span>
            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="student-user">

            <div class="user-avatar">
                <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
            </div>

            <div class="user-info">

                <strong>
                    {{c.data.userName}}
                </strong>

                <span>
                    Student
                </span>

            </div>

            <button
                class="logout-btn"
                ng-click="c.logout()">

                <i class="fa fa-sign-out"></i>

                Logout

            </button>

        </div>

    </header>


    <!-- =====================================
         MAIN LAYOUT
         ===================================== -->

    <div class="student-layout">


        <!-- =================================
             SIDEBAR
             ================================= -->

        <aside class="student-sidebar">

            <div class="sidebar-title">
                STUDENT MENU
            </div>


            <!-- Dashboard -->

            <a
                class="sidebar-item active"
                ng-click="c.dashboard()">

                <i class="fa fa-dashboard"></i>

                <span>
                    Dashboard
                </span>

            </a>


            <!-- Raise Request -->

            <a
                class="sidebar-item"
                ng-click="c.raiseRequest()">

                <i class="fa fa-plus-circle"></i>

                <span>
                    Raise a Request
                </span>

            </a>


            <!-- My Requests -->

            <a
                class="sidebar-item"
                ng-click="c.myRequests()">

                <i class="fa fa-list-alt"></i>

                <span>
                    My Requests
                </span>

            </a>


            <!-- Feedback -->

            <a
                class="sidebar-item"
                ng-click="c.feedback()">

                <i class="fa fa-comment"></i>

                <span>
                    Feedback
                </span>

            </a>


            <div class="sidebar-divider"></div>


            <!-- Help -->

            <a
                class="sidebar-item"
                href="#help">

                <i class="fa fa-question-circle"></i>

                <span>
                    Help
                </span>

            </a>

        </aside>


        <!-- =================================
             MAIN CONTENT
             ================================= -->

        <main class="student-content">


            <!-- PAGE TITLE -->

            <div class="welcome-section">

                <div>

                    <span class="page-label">
                        STUDENT DASHBOARD
                    </span>

                    <h1>
                        Welcome,
                        {{c.data.userName}}
                    </h1>

                    <p>
                        Manage your campus food requests
                        and track your dining experience.
                    </p>

                </div>


                <button
                    class="quick-request-btn"
                    ng-click="c.raiseRequest()">

                    <i class="fa fa-plus"></i>

                    Raise Request

                </button>

            </div>


            <!-- =================================
                 STATISTICS
                 ================================= -->

            <div class="stats-container">


                <!-- TOTAL REQUESTS -->

                <div class="stat-card">

                    <div class="stat-icon teal">
                        <i class="fa fa-file-text"></i>
                    </div>

                    <div class="stat-details">

                        <span>
                            Total Requests
                        </span>

                        <strong>
                            {{c.data.totalRequests}}
                        </strong>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <!-- ACTIVE REQUESTS -->

                <div class="stat-card">

                    <div class="stat-icon blue">
                        <i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i>
                    </div>

                    <div class="stat-details">

                        <span>
                            Active Requests
                        </span>

                        <strong>
                            {{c.data.activeRequests}}
                        </strong>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <!-- RESOLVED -->

                <div class="stat-card">

                    <div class="stat-icon green">
                        <i class="fa fa-check-circle"></i>
                    </div>

                    <div class="stat-details">

                        <span>
                            Resolved
                        </span>

                        <strong>
                            {{c.data.resolvedRequests}}
                        </strong>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <!-- FEEDBACK -->

                <div class="stat-card">

                    <div class="stat-icon orange">
                        <i class="fa fa-star"></i>
                    </div>

                    <div class="stat-details">

                        <span>
                            Feedback Given
                        </span>

                        <strong>
                            {{c.data.feedbackCount}}
                        </strong>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>


            <!-- =================================
                 QUICK ACTIONS
                 ================================= -->

            <section class="dashboard-section">

                <div class="section-heading">

                    <div>

                        <h2>
                            Quick Actions
                        </h2>

                        <p>
                            Frequently used student services
                        </p>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="action-grid">


                    <!-- RAISE REQUEST -->

                    <div
                        class="action-card"
                        ng-click="c.raiseRequest()">

                        <div class="action-icon teal-bg">

                            <i class="fa fa-plus"></i>

                        </div>

                        <h3>
                            Raise a Request
                        </h3>

                        <p>
                            Report food quality,
                            hygiene or dining issues.
                        </p>

                        <span class="action-link">
                            Create Request
                            <i class="fa fa-arrow-right"></i>
                        </span>

                    </div>


                    <!-- MY REQUESTS -->

                    <div
                        class="action-card"
                        ng-click="c.myRequests()">

                        <div class="action-icon blue-bg">

                            <i class="fa fa-list"></i>

                        </div>

                        <h3>
                            My Requests
                        </h3>

                        <p>
                            View and track all your
                            submitted requests.
                        </p>

                        <span class="action-link">
                            View Requests
                            <i class="fa fa-arrow-right"></i>
                        </span>

                    </div>


                    <!-- FEEDBACK -->

                    <div
                        class="action-card"
                        ng-click="c.feedback()">

                        <div class="action-icon orange-bg">

                            <i class="fa fa-star"></i>

                        </div>

                        <h3>
                            Give Feedback
                        </h3>

                        <p>
                            Share your experience
                            and help improve food services.
                        </p>

                        <span class="action-link">
                            Give Feedback
                            <i class="fa fa-arrow-right"></i>
                        </span>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </section>


            <!-- =================================
                 RECENT REQUESTS
                 ================================= -->

            <section class="dashboard-section">

                <div class="section-heading">

                    <div>

                        <h2>
                            Recent Requests
                        </h2>

                        <p>
                            Your latest food service requests
                        </p>

                    </div>


                    <button
                        class="view-all-btn"
                        ng-click="c.myRequests()">

                        View All

                        <i class="fa fa-arrow-right"></i>

                    </button>

                </div>


                <!-- EMPTY -->

                <div
                    class="empty-state"
                    ng-if="!c.data.recentRequests.length">

                    <div class="empty-icon">

                        <i class="fa fa-inbox"></i>

                    </div>

                    <h3>
                        No requests yet
                    </h3>

                    <p>
                        You haven't raised any food-related
                        requests yet.
                    </p>

                    <button
                        class="empty-btn"
                        ng-click="c.raiseRequest()">

                        Raise Your First Request

                    </button>

                </div>


                <!-- REQUEST LIST -->

                <div
                    class="request-list"
                    ng-if="c.data.recentRequests.length">

                    <div
                        class="request-row"
                        ng-repeat="request in c.data.recentRequests">

                        <div class="request-main">

                            <div class="request-icon">

                                <i class="fa fa-file-text"></i>

                            </div>

                            <div>

                                <h4>
                                    {{request.number}}
                                </h4>

                                <p>
                                    {{request.short_description}}
                                </p>

                            </div>

                        </div>


                        <div class="request-status">

                            <span
                                class="status-badge"
                                ng-class="request.statusClass">

                                {{request.state}}

                            </span>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </section>


            <!-- =================================
                 HELP
                 ================================= -->

            <section
                id="help"
                class="help-card">

                <div class="help-icon">

                    <i class="fa fa-question"></i>

                </div>

                <div class="help-content">

                    <h3>
                        Need Help?
                    </h3>

                    <p>
                        If you have an issue with your
                        campus food service, raise a request
                        and our team will assist you.
                    </p>

                </div>

                <button
                    ng-click="c.raiseRequest()"
                    class="help-btn">

                    Raise Request

                </button>

            </section>


        </main>

    </div>

</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
